name: Math-VR-bench
description:
Math-VR-bench: Benchmark for Mathematical Visual Reasoning (English Subset)
	




Math-VR-bench is the evaluation benchmark of the Math-VR, designed to measure mathematical visual reasoning capability in large language models and vision-language models. 

	
	
	
		🧠 Motivation
	

Existing math benchmarks (e.g., MATH-500, MathVista) focus on text reasoning. Math-VR-benchtargets visual reasoning—solving problems that require constructing auxiliary lines, plotting functions, or… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/gogoduan/Math-VR-bench.
reputation: A recently introduced dataset for visual mathematical reasoning that is gaining attention among researchers working on vision+language math problems but is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
